extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to perform web traversal through complex, multi-step interactions on a root website. It uses a question-answer format focused on text-based reasoning and includes 680 queries from four real-world scenarios across over 1373 webpages.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A two-stage funnel annotation pipeline was used: official websites were recursively traversed to collect accessible sub-links and pages, GPT-4o generated initial annotations and synthetic queries/QA pairs, and crowd-sourced human annotators then performed quality control, filtering, rewriting, and calibration.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Official websites, including accessible sub-links, their pages, webpage markdown content, clickable HTML buttons, and associated URLs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Two-stage funnel annotation combining GPT-4o initial annotation with crowd-sourced human quality control; humans rewrite and calibrate questions and answers and manually verify QA pairs for correctness, consistency, accuracy, and relevance.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human quality control, filtering, and manual verification were used to ensure QA pair correctness, consistency, accuracy, and relevance.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o was used for initial annotations and to generate synthetic QA pairs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited in size to 680 human-verified QA pairs despite task complexity; it currently relies only on HTML-DOM and excludes multimodal signals like screenshots; and the system is prompt-driven without additional training, with future work suggested for agent tuning and better RAG integration.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work is framed as improving scalable and reliable LLM-based web information retrieval and assisting web information seeking through integration with RAG systems.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The annotated data format includes language as a metadata field.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended as a benchmark for evaluating LLM web traversal and information-seeking QA, and the authors note that approximately 14k silver QA pairs may serve as supplementary training data to enhance agent performance.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is planned to be released on HuggingFace Datasets, and the code for WebWalker will be released on GitHub.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Two-stage annotation and filtering pipeline: recursive traversal of official websites to collect accessible sub-links/pages, GPT-4o initial annotation to construct queries, verification/filtering of illegitimate or unnatural queries, retaining only QA pairs with short entity answers, and human rewriting/calibration for correctness and consistency.
